1.0.0: Initial version. Adds RunModel, GenerateImage, SubmitRequest, GetRequestStatus, GetRequestResult, CancelRequest, UploadFile, DownloadFile, FindModels and MakeApiCall components with API key authentication.
1.0.1: Update connector icon to official fal.ai logo SVG for all components.
1.1.0: Fix authentication: validate the connection against /v1/models instead of /v1/storage/settings, which is ADMIN-only and rejected ordinary API-scoped keys with 403.
Fix Find Models: flatten the nested metadata object so all documented output fields (Display Name, Category, Status, Tags, ...) are actually available; previously only Endpoint Id was reachable.

Fix Get Request Status, Get Request Result and Cancel Request: build queue URLs from the owner/model base, matching the handles fal returns. Supplying a Model Endpoint Id with a variant (for example fal-ai/flux/schnell) previously failed with 405.
1.1.1: Fix Get Request Result: an unfinished request answers 400 'Request is still in progress', not 202, so it surfaced as a bare 'Request failed with status code 400'. It now returns the intended message telling you to poll Get Request Status first.
